mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hyperglycemia while amlodipine causes vasodilation and reflex tachycardia; additive hypotensive effects with potential electrolyte abnormalities.
action: Monitor blood pressure, serum potassium, and glucose regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent if hypokalemia develops; this combination is commonly used therapeutically but requires appropriate monitoring.
